Summary
Interlocking hex panel for mounting tool hooks and small bins. Panels clip
together edge to edge, so the wall grows one tile at a time.

Hex panel
A synthetic stand-in for a Printables model PDF. Every word of it was written
for this test suite; only the LINE STRUCTURE copies what pdfium produces for a
real Printables PDF (values exploded across lines, icon glyphs as stray single
letters, the author/title block after the changelog).
